entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say the reason for your call.
I need to make a return.
Connecting you to an agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I'd like to start a return for an order I placed a little while ago. It's for a helmet.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered on October 23rd. That was about 58 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference thing. The color just wasn't what I expected from the website photos, and it doesn't match the rest of my gear. The box is still unopened, I never even took it out.
I understand. Getting the right color to match is important. Let me just check our return policy for you.
Alright, I've confirmed it here. Since your item was delivered 58 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.

That's great to hear. Now, since I'll be paying to ship this helmet back and then ordering a new one, would it be possible to get a 10% discount code for my next purchase? I still need a helmet, and safety is my top priority, so I'll be buying from VeloFit again.

I appreciate you wanting to place another order with us. While I can't offer a discount code at this time, I can confirm you will receive a full refund for the original purchase price as soon as we receive the return. I've just sent the return authorization and shipping label to your email on file.
Okay, that's fair enough. I had to ask. A full refund works for me. I'll look for that email.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
